1. System Overview
ProjectAI vs Cancer — DermaTriage
PurposeAI-assisted dermatology triage for early skin cancer detection
InstitutionUniversity of Milan
SupervisorProf. Ernesto Damiani
DeveloperBasil
PlatformB4 (Social Things)
TeamRicardo Matamoros, Niccolo
Live URLhttps://5000--main--a14-cancer--basybasy00.coder.ricerca.sesar.di.unimi.it
B4 Portalhttps://aivscancer.b4service.it
GitHubgithub.com/basil-github/image_classifier
2. Four-Stage AI Pipeline
DermaTriage processes patient-submitted skin lesion images through a sequential four-stage AI pipeline, each stage
enriching the clinical context before the final triage decision.
StageModelInputOutput
1EfficientNet-B4 (fine-tuned)Skin lesion imageHIGH / MEDIUM / LOW + confidence
2Qwen2-VL-7B-InstructSkin lesion imageClinical text description (5-bullet format)
3RAG — ChromaDBClinical textTop-5 similar historical cases
4BioMistral-7BStage 1+2+3 + symptomsJSON: urgency, confidence, reasoning, pathology
Pipeline Flow:
1. Patient uploads image + age + sex + localization via B4 chatbot
2. Stage 1: predict_image() — EfficientNet classifies urgency (threshold: prob >= 0.25 for HIGH)
3. Stage 2: _call_qwen2() — Vision LLM generates 5-bullet clinical description
4. Stage 3: find_si
